camel_example: aliyun quickbi-public ModifyAiproEmbedConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ChatHistoryStatus 1 --Config test --MemoryEnabled 1 --UploadEnabled 1 --AgentName test --ShowName test --AiProId test --version 2022-01-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates or updates an AIPro embedding configuration
kebab_example: aliyun quickbi-public modify-aipro-embed-config --ai-pro-id test --show-name test --agent-name test --chat-history-status 1 --memory-enabled 1 --upload-enabled 1 --config test --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAiproEmbedConfig

parameters.help_en: The AIPro configuration ID. If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, a new configuration is created. If this parameter is specified, the existing configuration is updated
parameters.help_zh: AIPro配置 ID；不传或空白表示新建，非空表示修改
parameters.name: ai_pro_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the configuration. This parameter is required and must be unique within the organization when you create a configuration. If this parameter is left empty when you update a configuration, the name is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 配置名称；新建时必填且组织内唯一；修改时空白表示不更新
parameters.name: show_name

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the agent. The default value is Intelligent Data Analytics Assistant when you create a configuration
parameters.help_zh: 智能体昵称；新建默认“智能数据分析助手”
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display the chat history. Valid values:

1: Display.
0: Do not display.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
展示历史对话：

1=展示
0=不展示

新建默认 1
parameters.name: chat_history_status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable memory. Valid values:

1: Enable.
0: Disable.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
启用记忆：

1=开
0=关

新建默认 0
parameters.name: memory_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow file uploads. Valid values:

1: Allow.
0: Do not allow.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
允许上传文件：

1=开
0=关

新建默认 0
parameters.name: upload_enabled

parameters.help_en: The JSON string of the embedding appearance configuration saved on the frontend
parameters.help_zh: 前端保存的嵌入外观 JSON 字符串
parameters.name: config

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the operation. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.
false: The operation fails
Result.description_zh:
返回接口执行结果。取值范围：

true：执行成功
false：执行失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
